disclaimer: All figures are illustrative estimates based on actual Northeast travel averages. Prices fluctuate with seasonality and fuel rates.

budget.name: Backpacker & Student
budget.food: Local markets, Dhabas, authentic ethnic thalis (₹400 - ₹600/day)
budget.transport: Shared Sumos, state buses, local shared autos (₹400 - ₹700/day)
budget.activities: Self-guided nature walks, public viewpoint tickets (₹200 - ₹400/day)

mid_range.name: Comfort & Explorer
mid_range.food: Reputed restaurants, authentic multi-course thalis, cafes (₹800 - ₹1,400/day)
mid_range.transport: Dedicated private hatchback / shared SUV rental (₹1,500 - ₹2,500/day per group)
mid_range.activities: National Park safaris, certified local guides, entry passes (₹600 - ₹1,200/day)

luxury.name: Premium & Experiential
luxury.accommodation: Luxury Tea Estate Bungalow / 4-5 Star Mountain Resort (₹7,500 - ₹18,000/night)
luxury.food: Curated royal & tribal degustation menus, fine dining (₹1,800 - ₹3,500/day)
luxury.transport: Dedicated private 4WD SUV (Innova Crysta / Scorpio) with chauffeur (₹4,500 - ₹6,500/day)
luxury.activities: Private elephant/jeep safaris, private river yacht, cultural troupe bookings (₹2,000+/day)

typical_trip_estimates.description: Quick weekend in Shillong & Cherrapunji or Kaziranga.
Classic Assam & Meghalaya or West Sikkim circuit.
Comprehensive Arunachal or Nagaland Hornbill & Dzukou expedition.
